contexts.text: (In Jupiter) when they sit at table they do not sit on chairs or benches...
There was a table in the middle and benches round about it, yet they all seemed to me to be standing on the benches... TCR 460.
The benches or seats (in the temple) were continuous, being carried round in a circular sweep according to the shape of the temple, and the back seats were raised higher than the front ones.
